supervisor_sizing.entry: 2 tranches over ~6 weeks: first after the Oct 29 plan (equity size known), second on a dip toward ~$70 with the 10y stable or after the Dec FOMC, whichever comes first
supervisor_sizing.overlap: VST (power demand from data centres, rate-sensitive power); GOOGL (Google is Xcel's Pine Island ESA counterparty and Anthropic's largest compute partner). Otherwise a low-beta diversifier against NVDA, AMAT, AMZN, GOOGL.
supervisor_sizing.reason: Fair value is at spot, so the case is ~3% yield plus ~9% EPS growth and diversification, not mispricing. With the Fed tightening (25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16 [20]) and the 10y at 5.12% and ~19% realised vol, beating SPY on a Sharpe basis is somewhat less likely than not; near-term event risk (Oct-29 equity plan, MPUC freeze ruling, TX AG suit) argues for tranches and a modest cap.
open_flags: Credit: Moody's negative outlook on Xcel Energy Inc. (Baa1) and PSCo (A1), FFO/debt planned flat at ~16% (Q2 release, deck); a heavier equity plan on Oct 29 is the likely response.
